name: Robot maid (B-01)
about: The robot maid who boots kevinjiang's portfolio (BentoSite) in its prologue: VRoid's CC0 AvatarSample E, recoloured black, white and orange, with porcelain skin, a mouthless face, glowing irises and rigid robot hardware.

base.licence: CC0 (VRoid Hub: modification, redistribution and commercial use allowed, no credit needed)

style.notes: A custom style script instead of the generic rules: porcelain face without a mouth, recoloured outfit, scripted hardware and sculpted robot hands. Env: MAID_HANDS=primitive, MAID_CLOTH=generic.

parts.notes: Generated ear unit (renders/lochara-generated-ears.png). To use it instead of the scripted ears: set enabled to true and style.env.MAID_EARS to "none".

contract.notes: What BentoSite's src/components/Prologue/engine/robot.js loads: it throws on a missing bone and drives the blink morph (happy is also detected; irisOff isn't found on sample E).
